headline: Oaxaca leads growth in construction value
summary: According to Inegi's ENEC survey, 21 Mexican states recorded increases and 11 declines in construction value, with Guerrero showing the steepest fall at -41.7%.
why: The ENEC survey from Mexico's statistics agency tracks construction company activity across states, a gauge of regional investment.
original_headline: Oaxaca lidera crecimiento del valor de la construcción
